Thanks — Priya

Adding an ops-first view — draft runbook (6 steps) below. I kept it terse so SI/customer ops can follow quickly during the live session.

Draft Contingency Runbook (for demo day):
1) T-minus 60m: Verify primary host health (Redwood eu-central) — load ok, model warm, token pipeline engaged.
2) T-minus 30m: Confirm SI host readiness (Helix GCP instance) and confirm network routes; verify access for customer attendees.
3) T-minus 20m: Final attendee routing decision — if Azure maintenance window is active at T-minus 20m, announce fallback and send updated join link.
4) T-minus 10m: Warm KV cache for demo prompts on chosen host (ops task: Jonas).
5) Go/No-Go at T-minus 5m: If primary degraded, perform scripted redirect to SI host via federated join link and enable transient logging to shared drive.
6) Post-demo: Collect logs, annotate any latency/regression notes, and file a brief incident note to the deal record.

Attachments required from Helix before rehearsal:
- GCP host join URL + contact (Marco)
- Network diagram for Helix test endpoint (for quick NAT/ACL checks)
- Finalized demo slide deck (so we can validate asset availability on fallback host)

I'll attach the network diagram and a checklist. Jonas — you'll be backup host; can you confirm availability 2028-03-13 07:15–09:30 CET and again 14:30–16:00 CET?

Kimberly Park
